name: Treasure of the Timeless One
label: Quest
description: Treasure of the Timeless One: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, champion. I am Jonathan, keeper of the sacred gong and eternal watcher of the Bronze Flight.
I have been empowered by the Timeless One himself to grant you an item of your choosing from his timeless treasure trove. May it aid you in your battles against C'Thun.
